summary: The filing is an 8-K Item 8.01 Other Events, reporting routine monthly distributions declared by Starwood Real Estate Income Trust, Inc. for its common stock classes. Per share net distributions range from $0.0632 to $0.0770, payable on July 6, 2026 to stockholders of record as of June 30, 2026. No price, premium, or structural terms are present, and there is no board recommendation or advisor. This is a standard operating update, not a special situation.
